profile.headline: Software Engineer at Zoox Inc.
profile.summary: Armed with my collection of Rubik's cubes, and my ever growing collection of computers and servers, I aim to make the world a better place by pushing the boundaries of the Robotics industry. I hope to take robotics to the streets, into peoples homes, and even into space, while teaching the public about this wonderful technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer on the Calibration, Localization, and Mapping team, developing and maintaining sensor calibration suites

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed custom Gazebo simulation of a PR2 Robot for Hierarchical Task Network Learning from Demonstration. Designed a custom Java user interface to facilitate task demonstration. Created custom 3D models with realistic physical properties, and imported into Gazebo for tire rotation simulation.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed an interactive 3D Debugger for large multi-robot systems.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Organized laboratory experiments with Arduino platforms, for several undergraduate robotics classes. Aided classes of up to 50 students in understanding course material, including Python and C++ ROS Programming.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Integrated advanced sensors into existing BIOSwimmer platform

positions.title: Visiting Student
positions.description: Researched and provided recommendations on a new 3D biomolecule visualization program for high-school-aged students

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Constructed an interactive touchscreen application using Java to provide insights into large datasets.

honors.title: Teaching Assistant of the Year
honors.issuer: Issued by Michael Gennert - Robotics Department Head

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer counselor for Camp Fatima's Special Needs week

projects.title: MQP: Robosub
projects.description: Worked as part of a 12 person team to create a modular and autonomous underwater robot and testing platform for WPI

publications.title: Interactive Hierarchical Task Learning from a Single Demonstration
